title: Dyson CameraJet™ electric toothbrush (Ceramic pink)
excerpt: The only toothbrush with a camera to accurately target gaps. Powered by Gap Optical Targeting™. Removes plaque while you brush. In Ceramic pink. Shop now.
content_html:
¹ From assessment of publicly available market data conducted up to June 2026. Toothbrush in Brush and Auto-jet mode.

² In a clinical study of 204 participants, conducted over six weeks, brushing 2x per day in Brush and Auto-jet mode vs. a manual toothbrush.

³ In Deep clean mode vs. using a manual toothbrush, in lab-based tests.

⁴ vs. market leading premium electric toothbrushes in a laboratory test in brush-only variable mode in the hard to reach areas.

⁵ App functionality may vary per market. Requires internet connection/Wi-Fi and MyDyson™ app. Operating system and mobile device requirements for the MyDyson™ app can be found on the App Store or Google Play.

⁶ In Brush and Auto-jet, Deep clean mode vs. a manual toothbrush, in lab-based tests.

⁷ In Variable mode vs. manual toothbrush in lab-based tests.

⁸ https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC10906797/

⁹ https://jada.ada.org/article/S0002-8177(24)00188-0/abstract

¹⁰ https://www.nidcr.nih.gov/research/data-statistics/periodontal-disease/adults

¹¹ Used with Dyson mouth rinse vs. a manual toothbrush

¹² vs. using a reference abrasive in a lab-based test.

¹³ With twice-daily use.

¹⁴ Scientifically tested in a laboratory using Dyson’s proprietary proxy plaque, developed in a funded research collaboration with the National University of Singapore, Faculty of Dentistry. Comparing needle-shaped jets vs. Dyson's conical jet.
